evals.prompt: Make a carousel about why most people's content calendars fall apart by week two.
evals.expected_output: Should write carousel/outputs/<slug>/carousel.json with one theme and one font, 6-9 slides starting with a cover_image slide and ending with a cta slide tied to backbone/offer.md, a textless cover concept ending in the no text/no screens/no UI/no logos clause, body copy in the voice from voice-dna.md with no emoji on slides, then run cover.py and render.js --preview as the approval gate before the final PNG render.
assertions: Uses exactly one theme and one font for the deck
Has 6-9 slides, cover_image first and cta last
Cover concept is textless with no UI metaphors
Shows the --preview deck for approval before rendering final PNGs
CTA comes from backbone/offer.md and nothing on its NOT-sold list
